info.title: Delta Registry — Santa Fe Argentina Licitaciones - Tender Delta API
info.description: Scrape and monitor every public tender of Santa Fe Province, Argentina: licitaciones, concursos and contrataciones directas of ministries, hospitals and SAMCOs, with buyer, budget, deadlines, rubros, expediente and pliego/circular/acta PDF links. Delta mode flags new, changed and amended tenders.

post.summary: Start an async run of: Scrape and monitor every public tender of Santa Fe Province, Argentina: licitaciones, concursos and contrataciones directas of ministries, hospitals and SAMCOs, with buyer, budget, deadlines, rubros, expediente and pliego/circular/acta PDF links. Delta mode flags new, changed and amended tenders.
post.x-async-pattern-reason: No production run history exists for this actor — defaulting to the async run+poll pattern as a precaution, not a measurement. Re-run this generator once real telemetry exists to potentially switch it to sync.

estados.description: Which lists to read. AP = Para Apertura (published, offers not yet opened - where every new tender appears first), ET = En Trámite (opened, being evaluated - actas and preadjudicación land here), CO = Concluida (finished). Each is a separate server-side query.

anio.description: Year of the process number (anioGestion). The site's own UI always applies the current year; leave empty for all years (2000 onwards).

objeto.description: Case-insensitive phrase search over the tender subject, e.g. 'limpieza', 'medicamentos', 'servicio de vigilancia'. Word order matters ('servicio de limpieza' matches, 'limpieza servicio' does not).

tipoGestion.description: One server-side query per selected type. Codes are the site's own (L = Licitación Pública, P = Licitación Privada, T = Contratación Directa, ...).

tipoModalidad.description: Contracting modality code from the site.

comprador.description: The organism running the procedure, as its site id (idOrganismoLey12510, e.g. 27) or a distinctive part of its name (e.g. 'Administración Provincial de Impuestos', 'Hospital Cullen'). Names are matched against the site's own organism list at run start; an ambiguous name fails with the candidates listed.

solicitante.description: The organism the purchase is for, same id space and name matching as 'Buyer' (e.g. 'Ministerio de Salud').

rubro.description: Product/service category, as the site's idEspecie (e.g. 29) or part of its name (e.g. 'medicinales', 'limpieza', 'alimentos'). Matched against the site's 78 rubros at run start.

subrubro.description: Sub-category within the selected rubro, as idFamilia or part of its name. Requires 'Category (rubro)'.

nroGestion.description: Exact process number as printed on the site, e.g. '18' or '02' (combine with the year: several organisms share the same numbering).

nroExpediente.description: Exact, full expediente number, e.g. 'EE-2026-00001797-APPSF-OD' (partial values match nothing on the site).

openingFrom.description: Only tenders whose bid opening (fecha de apertura) is on or after this date. Absolute (2026-09-01) or relative: '7 days' counts back from today, '+7 days' counts forward (Santa Fe calendar). Applied client-side after fetching the listing (the site has no date filter) - rows outside the window are simply skipped and not remembered.

openingTo.description: Only tenders opening on or before this date. Absolute or relative ('+30 days' = opening within the next month). Client-side.

eventTypes.description: NEW_LISTING = a process never delivered before; STATUS_CHANGE = a known process that moved to another estado (AP -> ET -> CO); UPDATED = a known open process whose detail page changed (a circular aclaratoria, an acta de apertura, a preadjudicación report, a new opening date...). The last two exist in delta mode only.

onlyNew.description: Remembers every process it has delivered (per filter set, in a named key-value store) with the estado it was in and a fingerprint of its detail page, and returns only processes that are new, moved to another estado, or were amended since. Each estado list is walked newest-first and stops as soon as it reaches already-known records.

recheckWindowDays.description: Delta mode with detail: known processes whose opening date is within this many days in the past (or any time in the future) get their detail page re-read every run to detect amendments (UPDATED). The register shows no 'last modified' signal, so this re-read is the only way to see a new circular or acta. 0 disables it. Re-reads are not charged unless something changed.

sortBy.description: 'newest' (idGestion descending = most recently created first) is required for delta mode. 'openingSoonest' / 'openingLatest' order by bid-opening date; 'mostViewed' by the site's own view counter (full runs only).

deltaStateName.description: Optional label for the memory of a monitoring task. Defaults to a fingerprint of your filters, so different schedules never interfere. Set the same name on two tasks to make them share one memory.

resetState.description: Forget every previously delivered process for this delta state and re-baseline (the run then returns up to 'Max records' newest processes).

maxItems.description: Hard cap on delivered records (and therefore on cost: you pay per record). In delta mode anything beyond the cap is simply delivered by the next run.

fetchDetail.description: Opens each process page (one extra request) for the publication timestamp, budget (Monto Original), submission deadline, places, rubros, requesting organism, contact, expediente and the pliego / circular / acta / preadjudicación document links. Off = listing-only summary records (cheaper 'result-summary' price; no UPDATED detection and no status sweep).

maxConcurrency.description: How many process pages are fetched at once. The site answers a page in 0.1-0.3 s and tolerated 10 in parallel without throttling; 5 is a polite default.

dateRange.description: Kept for tasks created with version 1: '24h', '7d' or '30d' are interpreted as an opening-date window of that many days before AND after today.

201.description: Run started. Poll GET /actor-runs/{runId} with the returned run id until status is SUCCEEDED, then fetch its dataset items.

get.summary: Poll the status of a previously started run.

200.description: Current run status. When status is SUCCEEDED, fetch the dataset via GET /datasets/{datasetId}/items, passing this response's defaultDatasetId field as {datasetId}.

get.summary: Fetch the dataset items produced by a completed run.

200.description: Array of normalized records from the actor run.

items.title: Santa Fe tenders (Gestiones de Compra)
items.description: One item per procurement process of the Province of Santa Fe's Gestiones de Compra register. The version-1 fields and the `detail` object are kept verbatim; normalised twins (UTC instants, numeric amounts with currency, document kinds, booleans) sit next to them. Records are appended oldest-first within a run; read newest-first with ?desc=true.

record_id.title: Record ID
record_id.description: Same value as idGestion - stable across runs (e.g. 138825).

event_type.title: Event type
event_type.description: NEW_LISTING (never delivered before), STATUS_CHANGE (known process moved AP -> ET -> CO), UPDATED (known open process whose detail page changed: circular, acta, preadjudicación, new date...).

scraped_at.title: Scraped at
scraped_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of this extraction (same for every record of one run).

is_new.title: Is new
is_new.description: true when this process was never delivered by a previous run of this delta state.

data_source.title: Data source
data_source.description: Attribution string (Gobierno de Santa Fe, CC BY-SA 2.5 AR).

idGestion.title: ID gestión
idGestion.description: The register's own numeric process id, as a string.

estado.title: Estado
estado.description: The list the process was found in: AP (Para Apertura), ET (En Trámite), CO (Concluida). For a STATUS_CHANGE found by the status sweep, the estado the detail page reports.

tipoGestion.title: Tipo de gestión
tipoGestion.description: Procedure type as printed, e.g. LICITACIÓN PÚBLICA, CONTRATACIÓN DIRECTA.

numeroGestion.title: Número de gestión
numeroGestion.description: Process number within the organism and year, e.g. 18.

anioGestion.title: Año
anioGestion.description: Year of the process number, e.g. 2026.

fechaHoraApertura.title: Fecha de apertura (raw)
fechaHoraApertura.description: Opening date as the listing prints it, DD-MM-YYYY. Null for a record rebuilt from the detail page only.

valorPliego.title: Valor del pliego (raw)
valorPliego.description: Price of the bid documents as free text ('NO APLICA', 'SIN COSTO', '$ 8209,50 (PESOS ...)').

numeroExpediente.title: Número de expediente (listing)
numeroExpediente.description: File number as the listing prints it - often blank; see expediente for the detail-page value.

detail.title: Detail (v1 shape)
detail.description: The version-1 detail object kept for compatibility: fields (label -> value), rubros[] and documentos[] {tipo, nombre, url}. Null when fetchDetail=false or the page is unavailable.

idGestionNumber.title: ID gestión (number)
idGestionNumber.description: idGestion as a number - the register's creation order and the delta engine's ordering key.

tipoGestionCode.title: Tipo de gestión (code)
tipoGestionCode.description: The site's letter code for tipoGestion (L, P, A, T, B, V, C, I, D, S, X, Y, O).

idOrganismoGestion.title: ID organismo (listing)
idOrganismoGestion.description: The listing's internal organism id (a different id space from the comprador filter's idOrganismoLey12510).

objetoCompleto.title: Objeto completo
objetoCompleto.description: Full subject text from the listing.

destinos.title: Destinos
destinos.description: Delivery / recipient organism text (ET and CO rows only).

fechaHoraAperturaFija.title: Fecha y hora de apertura (raw)
fechaHoraAperturaFija.description: Opening timestamp as the API prints it, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss Santa Fe time.

openingAt.title: Opening at
openingAt.description: Bid opening instant, UTC ISO-8601 (Santa Fe is UTC-3).

daysUntilOpening.title: Days until opening
daysUntilOpening.description: Negative once the opening has passed.

valorPliegoAmount.title: Valor del pliego (amount)
valorPliegoAmount.description: Numeric price of the bid documents when one is quoted.

valorPliegoIsFree.title: Pliego is free
valorPliegoIsFree.description: true for 'NO APLICA' / 'SIN COSTO' / '$ 0'; false when a price is quoted; null when undecidable.

previousEstado.title: Previous estado
previousEstado.description: For STATUS_CHANGE: the estado the process was last delivered in.

isElectronic.title: Electronic procedure
isElectronic.description: true when the expediente matches the pattern the site uses to show its 'Ofertar' button (bids via gestionvirtual.santafe.gob.ar).

bidUrl.title: Bid URL
bidUrl.description: gestionvirtual.santafe.gob.ar bid form for electronic procedures.

printPdfUrl.title: Print PDF URL
printPdfUrl.description: Print-ready PDF of the whole record (output.php?a=gestiones.ver&print=1).

detailFetched.title: Detail fetched
detailFetched.description: true when the detail page was read and parsed (charged as 'result'); false for listing-only records ('result-summary').

detailError.title: Detail error
detailError.description: UNPUBLISHED when the site says the process does not exist / is not published yet; otherwise null.

estadoLabel.title: Estado (detail label)
estadoLabel.description: The detail page's own Estado text, e.g. 'PARA APERTURA', 'EN TRÁMITE - Análisis de ofertas', 'CONCLUIDA'.

estadoStage.title: Estado stage
estadoStage.description: Evaluation stage suffix of the estado label, when present.

estadoFromDetail.title: Estado (detail code)
estadoFromDetail.description: AP / ET / CO derived from estadoLabel.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: Publication instant, UTC ISO-8601 - the only true publication timestamp on the register (never changes, even when documents are added later).

organismoComitente.title: Organismo comitente
organismoComitente.description: Requesting body / bodies the purchase is for.

submissionPlace.title: Lugar de presentación de ofertas
submissionPlace.description: Where / how offers are submitted (often an e-mail or the gestionvirtual link).

submissionDeadline.title: Submission deadline
submissionDeadline.description: Offer submission deadline, UTC ISO-8601 - distinct from the opening; the date suppliers schedule against.

openingNote.title: Opening note
openingNote.description: Text after the opening date on the detail page, e.g. '(*** NUEVA FECHA ***)'.

contactInfo.title: Contacto para información
contactInfo.description: Institutional contact text as published (phone / e-mail).

contactEmails.title: Contact e-mails
contactEmails.description: E-mail addresses found in the contact and submission fields, lower-cased.

montoOriginalText.title: Monto Original (raw)
montoOriginalText.description: Budget / estimated value as printed, e.g. '$ 207.302.040,00' or 'U$S 60.000,00'.

montoOriginalAmount.title: Monto Original (amount)
montoOriginalAmount.description: Numeric budget. Under Argentine inflation compare with publishedDate; never converted.

expedientes.title: Expedientes
expedientes.description: File numbers from the detail page with the tracker link (expedientes-web / SIE).

expediente.title: Expediente
expediente.description: First expediente code from the detail page (the listing's numeroExpediente is often blank).

expedienteUrl.title: Expediente URL
expedienteUrl.description: Link to the province's file tracker.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free-form 'IMPORTANTE' blocks some buyers add to the page.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Every attachment with a normalised kind: pliego, circular, llamado, acta_apertura, nomina_oferentes, cuadro_comparativo, informe_comision, preadjudicacion, adjudicacion, orden_provision, documento_provision, planimetria, otros.

hasCircular.title: Has circular
hasCircular.description: A circular aclaratoria/modificatoria was published - the pliego changed.

hasAdjudicacion.title: Has adjudicación
hasAdjudicacion.description: A 'Norma Legal de Adjudicación' (award decision) was published.

hasCuadroComparativo.title: Has cuadro comparativo
hasCuadroComparativo.description: A price comparison table was published.

contentHash.title: Content hash
contentHash.description: SHA-1 fingerprint of the detail page's data and documents - the delta engine's change key (null for listing-only records).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Newest activity first: what is being tendered, by whom, budget, opening.

deadlines.title: Deadlines & openings
deadlines.description: Bid calendar: submission deadline, opening date, days left, electronic bid link.

documents.title: Documents & awards
documents.description: Which stage each process reached: pliego, circulares, acta, preadjudicación, adjudicación, orden de provisión.

buyers.title: Buyers & contacts
buyers.description: Who is buying, for whom, in which rubros, and how to reach the procurement office.

changes.title: Status changes & amendments
changes.description: Delta events: transitions between estados and amended detail pages.
